messages:
Maria (mktg): Quick sync — we need audience-segmentation copy tests for the webinar launch next week. Can we draft 3 variations per segment (X short thread + LinkedIn long-form)?
AJ (growth): ✅ Which segments are we targeting?
Maria (mktg): SMB devs, Platform eng, Data science. Priorities: bench narrative for DS, cost/latency for Platform, ROI for SMB.
Noah (content): I can do 3 headline hooks + 2 body lengths each. Will aim for punchy X first, then expand for LI.
Tess (demand gen): We have hero GIF + 3 stat cards in Figma — link: https://figma.com/s/redwood-webinar-assets (view-only). Need final-crop sizes for X cards (1200x675) and LI (1200x630).
Maria (mktg): @Noah, brief for DS: lead with a benchmark claim, then one-sentence methodology note. For Platform: a two-liner about predictable throughput + cost.
Noah (content): Draft headline for DS: "Real-workbench: 3x cost reduction on production LLM inference". Short X variant: "Cut inference cost 3x — real workload benchmarks inside 👇"
AJ (growth): Can we run CTA A/B? A: "Register" B: "See benchmark + register". Prefer B on LinkedIn, A on X.
Tess (demand gen): Routing: LinkedIn signups -> webinar list (marketing:webinars). X replies that include email -> SDR inbox. @LeadRouterBot can you set rules?
LeadRouterBot: Rule created: `linkedin->marketing:webinars` and `x_reply_with_email->sales:sdr-inbox`. Tags: #webinar_apr, source=linkedin|x. Starting now.
Maria (mktg): Also add UTM params: `utm_source={source}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr`. Use `utm_content` for variant id (A/B).
Noah (content): I'll drop the drafts here by EOD. Example LI opener: "Benchmarks matter — deploying LLM features at scale means optimizing serving costs and latency. Join our webinar to see real customer workloads and configurations that cut costs while preserving quality"
AJ (growth): Scheduling ask — plan X thread Tue 9am PT, LinkedIn Tue 10am PT. Tess, can you queue in Sprout?
Tess (demand gen): Yep, will queue and set the A/B tags. I'll post back when queued + screenshot.
Maria (mktg): Tiny test: can we try an influencer quote card for DS segment? Short pull-quote from an existing partner about throughput.
Noah (content): I have one quote from Beta Partner: "Saved ~40% on token costs without quality loss" — will format into a card.
AJ (growth): Nice. Also track clicks to gated benchmark + email capture rates per segment. Set dashboard widget under marketing -> webinars.
Tess (demand gen): Will create dashboard. Also setting auto-follow for X replies: tag and ping SDR channel.
Maria (mktg): Perfect. Thanks team :thumbsup: Let’s reconvene after drafts are up.
